Knowledge of the process.
Support along the way.

Special economic zones sit at the centre of our practice. Chief Iniobong S. Jackson represented the Manufacturers Association of Nigeria on the governing council of OGFZA and is Technical Adviser to the Africa Free Zones Association.

AIL’s international engagements include hosting Chinese investors at the Calabar Free Trade Zone in 2014 and engagement with Atlantic LNG and business chambers in Trinidad & Tobago.

Feasibility & land use

Reviewing a zone’s suitability for the proposed operations and aligning plans with relevant guidelines.

Application development

Preparing business cases, investment projections, application documents and technical layouts.

Regulatory engagement

Liaison with OGFZA, zone authorities and stakeholders, with advisory on Nigerian Content compliance and incentives.

Project setup support

Continued support through approval and setup, including logistics, manpower sourcing and training programmes.

FEATURED ENGAGEMENT · IN PROGRESS

Free Zone Enterprise registration
& land allocation application.

Liberty Oil & Gas Free Zone, Akwa Ibom State

AIL is supporting a Nigerian EPCI / oil and gas company with an application for Free Zone Enterprise registration and allocation of 10 hectares of land. The client’s name is withheld for confidentiality.

  • Drafted the application letter and regulatory correspondence submitted to OGFZA.
  • Handled regulatory liaison and follow-up on the application.
  • Developed a presentation covering facility scope, cost estimate, funding structure, financial viability and local-content impact.
  • Coordinated client preparation ahead of the regulatory meeting.

Progress: OGFZA acknowledged the application and invited the client to a meeting to discuss the investment. The application remains in progress; approval and land allocation are not presented as completed.
